##### Project general facts

Palm Jebel Ali Villas by Nakheel is an exclusive beachfront residential community where each frond is designed as a private neighbourhood surrounded by lush greenery and pristine beaches. The villas offer a refined coastal lifestyle, with elegant streets, carefully landscaped surroundings, and a strong focus on privacy and tranquillity. Thoughtfully planned open spaces and generous greenery create a peaceful setting where residents can enjoy the beauty of the beachfront environment.

The community is designed around an active outdoor lifestyle, with wide walkable streets and dedicated routes for pedestrians and cyclists connecting residents to the beach through landscaped pocket parks. Tree-lined corridors, layered planting, gentle street lighting, and shaded pathways create a lush and inviting environment for walking, relaxation, and family activities. The seamless connection between the residences, greenery, and beachfront enhances the sense of exclusivity and serenity.

The villas feature bespoke finishing using high-quality materials, with interiors designed to create a sophisticated connection with the surrounding nature. The show kitchens are enhanced by precious natural materials and fitted appliances, while extensive floor-to-ceiling glazing fills the interiors with abundant natural light and brings the outdoor landscape inside. The residences are offered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Palm Jebel Ali is a stunning man-made island located off the coast of Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Resembling a palm tree when viewed from above, this ambitious project is a testament to Dubai's innovation and engineering prowess.

The development on Palm Jebel Ali is set to include a wide range of residential, commercial, and leisure facilities. It is designed to be a self-sustaining community, with infrastructure that includes roads, bridges, and utilities. The island is planned to be connected to the mainland of Dubai via a bridge and accessible through a monorail system.

Palm Jebel Ali is a testament to Dubai's dedication to creating unique and luxurious living environments. With its stunning location and ambitious vision, it promises to offer a lifestyle that blends natural beauty, modern amenities, and the allure of coastal living. As it nears completion, it represents an exciting chapter in Dubai's ongoing development and innovation.
